trends.title: Top-opening takes off
trends.short: Access a deep main compartment without opening two halves across the hotel floor.
trends.description: Front and top access are moving across price tiers. Away Topside and July Capsule revisit the single-compartment format, while LOJEL Cubo and Japanese front-opening cases offer established functional benchmarks. Access architectures differ: a laptop door is not the same as full front-panel packing.
trends.implication: Prototype compact-footprint packing and demonstrate access with a fully packed case. Check door durability and usable depth.

trends.title: Colour gets confident
trends.short: Warm earth tones meet saturated blue, orange, pink and glossy finishes.
trends.description: RIMOWA’s October Umber and Ultramarine launch, LOJEL’s October Deep Cocoa and Blushed Earth, and July’s 2026 Endless Summer palette show multiple colour directions coexisting. These are documented assortment signals, not proof that neutral luggage has lost demand.
trends.implication: Build a dependable neutral base with a controlled seasonal colour capsule; validate colour acceptance and scuff visibility.

trends.title: Aluminium widens its reach
trends.short: Metal construction now spans more brands, price points and colour expressions.
trends.description: Delsey introduced Alu’r in September 2026, joining established metal players and newer ranges at Monos, Carl Friedrik and RAWROW. Full aluminium, a metal frame with a plastic shell, and metallic finishes are distinct constructions and should be labeled separately.
trends.implication: Compare weight, dent behavior, repair cost and landed cost. A hybrid frame can offer a different proposition from a full-metal case.

trends.title: Useful details become the story
trends.short: Wheel brakes, adjustable handles and quick-access hooks address visible travel friction.
trends.description: Away Series 3 makes wheel control and handle adjustment prominent. July Capsule combines lockable wheels and a quick-access magnetic door. These upgrades can be easy to explain, but their real value depends on reliability and intuitive operation.
trends.implication: Prioritize a few proven, demonstrable functions. Test brake activation, wheel roll under load and handle wobble before adding decorative extras.

trends.title: Heritage becomes collectable
trends.short: Trunk forms, leather accents and collaborations connect luggage with identity.
trends.description: July’s September American Airlines collaboration, Globe-Trotter’s PEANUTS capsule and leather-trim travel cases turn familiar formats into collectible design stories. A collaboration announcement is evidence of creative activity, not verified sell-through.
trends.implication: Explore ownable colour and trim combinations before expensive licensing. Validate attach rate and repeat demand separately from social attention.

trends.title: Repair is a design feature
trends.short: Replaceable parts and service access support a longer ownership story.
trends.description: Bellroy emphasizes repairable parts; luxury aluminum cases also increasingly discuss serviceability. Recycled content is a material claim, while repairability is an ownership feature. Neither by itself establishes a full life-cycle environmental advantage.
trends.implication: Ask suppliers for spare-wheel availability, repair instructions and verified material documentation. Include service cost in the offer design.

trends.title: Travel becomes a coordinated system
trends.short: A roller, personal item and packing accessories form a single visual family.
trends.description: Away’s Signature bags, Antler Icon accessories and lifestyle-led brands extend beyond the roller. Coordinated systems create merchandising and attachment opportunities, but accessories should preserve a clear role and price ladder.
trends.implication: Test a tightly edited carry-on, personal-item bag and organizer bundle. Measure accessory attachment instead of assuming all guests want a set.

trends.title: Softside stays relevant
trends.short: Fabric rollers and wheeled duffels solve different trips from a hard-shell spinner.
trends.description: Travelpro, Thule, Osprey and outdoor brands continue to offer flexible packing and travel-oriented organization. BÉIS Pro adds rugged materials and hybrid formats. The evidence supports parallel use cases, not a universal switch away from hard shells.
trends.implication: Maintain explicit guest missions: frequent work travel, family packing, adventure and occasional trips. Test wheels on rough surfaces, not only smooth floors.

featureThemes.title: Front / top access
featureThemes.benefit: Retrieve essentials or pack in a smaller floor footprint.
featureThemes.examples: July Capsule, Away Topside, LOJEL Cubo.
featureThemes.check: Test full packing access versus a laptop-only door; protect hinges and zippers under overload.

featureThemes.title: Wheel brakes & quiet rolling
featureThemes.benefit: Keep the case in place on slopes and moving transport.
featureThemes.examples: Away Series 3, July Capsule, MUJI adjustable-handle cases.
featureThemes.check: Validate rolling resistance, brake usability, wheel durability and spare-part supply.

featureThemes.title: Tracking: hardware or a pocket?
featureThemes.benefit: A compatible tracking device may help locate a misplaced case.
featureThemes.examples: July CaseSafe includes tracking capability; Away offers a tracker holder/pocket.
featureThemes.check: Disclose what is included, phone/network compatibility and any power requirements. A tracker pocket is not a tracker.

featureThemes.title: Expansion & compression
featureThemes.benefit: Adapt packing volume and stabilize contents.
featureThemes.examples: Briggs & Riley Sympatico, Travelpro VersaPack+, expandable Japanese cases.
featureThemes.check: Check airline dimensions after expansion, packed balance and zipper stress. Compression does not reduce weight.

featureThemes.title: Handle ergonomics
featureThemes.benefit: Improve grip and control for different traveler heights.
featureThemes.examples: Away continuously adjustable trolley; LEVEL8 Voyageur wide handle.
featureThemes.check: Test extension under load, handle wobble, pinch points and internal packing-space tradeoffs.

featureThemes.title: Materials & repairability
featureThemes.benefit: Match appearance, weight and ownership needs to the travel mission.
featureThemes.examples: Full-metal Monos, hybrid frames, plastic shells, Bellroy replacement parts.
featureThemes.check: Specify polymer and recycled-content basis; distinguish cosmetic dents from functional failure; validate service economics.
